title: ACKS2 Downtime Wizard
description: A wizard for the ACKS II downtime work rules. Calculates what a character earns between adventures: selling spellcasting services, sustaining perpetual spells, hiring out as a specialist, plying Art/Craft, Profession or Performance, labouring, gambling, arbitrage trading, a mercantile venture's whole month, hijinks by crew or alone, and a syndicate boss's month. Shows which activities earn campaign XP and which only pay gold, divides a venture's profit between its owners and its crew and a hijink's loot among whoever got away, and files finished records in a per-character journal.
